description: Nine straight-through connections, each with a text field you type a name into, for labelling cables where they cross a patch

inputs.text: One end of that row's connection; whatever comes in here leaves the output on the same row untouched

outputs.text: Carries whatever is patched into that row's input, untouched

notes: click a text field and type to name that row, and the text is saved with the patch; the fields are drawn by the module rather than placed as widgets, so none of them can be clicked for help
each row copies one channel only, so a polyphonic cable comes out of the row as a single channel
a row's output is written only while its own input is patched; pull the input out and the output holds the last voltage it carried
